gizmo.title: Pūrere patopato
gizmo.description: Kupu ka patopato i a ia anō, kotahi pū i te wā.

configure.title: Kuputuhi
configure.description: Te kuputuhi hei patopato ina panuku mai te huānga ki te tirohanga.

configure.title: E patopato ana
configure.description: Whakaaturia te pehu kimokimo; ka tautuhia tēnei e te huānga i a ia e patopato ana.

advanced.title: Takaware
advanced.description: Ngā hautekau mano hēkona hei tatari i mua i te tīmatanga o te patopato.

advanced.title: Te roa o te pehu
advanced.description: Ngā hautekau mano hēkona e kimokimo tonu ai te pehu i muri i te patopatohia o te kuputuhi.

advanced.title: Tere
advanced.description: Ngā hautekau mano hēkona mō ia pūāhua; ka tere ake te patopato a ngā tau iti ake.
